title: MONSTER CFB Game Total Page 1 — Unified Today + Duplicate + Runtime Repair
problem: Page 1 can show duplicate date controls, omit Phoenix-local today by reviving the legacy Tomorrow+ selector, and then surface the stale-date RuntimeError after the selected-day snapshot has already been pinned.
root_cause: V41 correctly owns the authoritative Phoenix selector and suppresses the legacy day strip, but the downstream V36 presentation wrapper reassigns the legacy day-strip function during the same render. That defeats V41 ownership, resurrects the Tomorrow+ strip, can rewrite the query date mid-render, and can diverge downstream reads from V42's pinned selected-day snapshot.
patch: Add V45 as an additive Page-1 compatibility owner that preserves the V41 day owner while reusing only V36 kickoff/hero presentation, plus one thin production overlay above frozen Step 9 that points Page 1 at V45 and delegates Page 2/other routes unchanged.
acceptance: one authoritative Phoenix-local Page-1 day selector
today remains selectable and is not future-filtered
legacy Tomorrow+ strip cannot render in the V45 native path
selected-day snapshot remains stable for the complete render
existing V44 stale-date RuntimeError protection remains preserved
Page-2 Step 9 fast-switch and Step-10 final certification remain unchanged
